text_block_list.text:
Starting today is the "Summer Training Camp"—
Intensive training to improve skills begins.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: It's summer! The ocean! It's training camp time~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Staying overnight somewhere different from usual
is kind of exciting, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's go swimming right away!
I'm pretty confident in my swimming, after all!
choice_data_list: Be careful not to get too carried away.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry! After all, Trainer, 
you'll be watching over me properly, right?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna make the most of this training camp and give it my all,
so Trainer, keep an eye on me
so I don't overdo it!
And so, our fiery summer training camp with Tokai Teio began.
